passPctReasoning: CVCL passes CELI 2 on two parts: at least 72 of 120 (60%) on the whole written part (reading 40, writing 40, listening 40) and the oral minimum (22 of 40; the CELI 2 i cittadinanza sheet says 11 on the 20-point scale). There is no separate line for reading alone, and only reading and its completion tasks are modelled. 70% (35 of 50) is Tigertest's readiness target: a margin above 60%, because the objective reading part is the one candidates usually score highest on and the writing and listening parts are not practised here.
blueprintComment: Real exam (CVCL, Università per Stranieri di Perugia; Regolamento degli esami CELI 2024 and cvcl.unistrapg.it pages, checked 2026-11-12): CELI 2 = CEFR B1, written part of three components (comprensione della lettura, produzione scritta, comprensione dell'ascolto; competenza linguistica only from CELI 3) plus an oral of up to 10-12 minutes; written 120 points, passed at 72, oral 40, results as grades A, B, C (pass) and D, E (fail). Only part A (reading) is modelled: short notices (A.1 style), longer texts with two questions each (A.2 style) and the completion and rewording tasks of part A (A.3 to A.5, and the 'riformulazioni di frasi' the CVCL lists), as grammar and vocabulary in context. CVCL publishes no item split for this; the 22 reading / 28 language split of each 50 is Tigertest's, following part A's balance of comprehension to completion items. Four options here (real A.1 and A.4 have three). All items original.

examFacts.answer: CELI 2 is the B1 Italian certificate of the CVCL at the Università per Stranieri di Perugia, for adults who can manage everyday social and working situations in Italian. The written part (reading, writing and listening, 120 points) needs 72 to pass and the oral, a role-play and a picture description of about 10 to 12 minutes, has its own minimum; results are graded A, B or C to pass and D or E to fail. A citizenship version, CELI 2 i cittadinanza, meets the B1 language requirement for Italian citizenship.

claudeMdBullet: - **CELI 2** (`itceli`, the CVCL's CELI 2 Italian language certificate at CEFR B1, Università per Stranieri di Perugia, including the CELI 2 i cittadinanza version for the citizenship language requirement, native-language exam in Italian, `language: "it"`, `locale: "it-IT"`, English names in `english`, `review: { it: "model" }`, `/celi-2-b1/*`, landing `/it/celi-2-b1-test` from `lib/landings/itceli.it.json`): `data/italy-celi-2-questions.json` (200 original questions written in Italian on part A of the written exam: notices and short messages 40, emails, letters and articles 48 (24 texts, two questions each), verbs 32, pronouns and possessives 20, prepositions and articles 20, connectives and rewording 16, vocabulary and expressions 24), four 50-question tests (IDs 27501-27504, 10/12/8/5/5/4/6 per test, Tigertest's split, no spares) and five Italian-named topic sets 27501-27505 (40/48/32/40/40), 9 dashboard steps, state `ITCELI`, prefix `ITCELI-`, 70% readiness line (35 of 50, Tigertest's: the real written part of reading, writing and listening is 120 points, passed at 72, with its own oral minimum; grades A, B, C pass, D, E fail; Regolamento degli esami CELI 2024). CELI 2 has no separate competenza linguistica component (it starts at CELI 3): the grammar and vocabulary items model part A's completion and rewording tasks. Writing, listening and the oral are not modelled; real A.1 and A.4 items have three options, ours four. The generic CELI 2 PDFs on unistrapg.it blocked automated fetching, so per-task counts come from search extracts and the CELI 2 i criteria sheet (copy hosted by an exam centre). Grammar to the Profilo della lingua italiana B1 inventory; every grammar item has one form accepted in standard written Italian. Built by `tools/next100/itceli/build.py`; sources in `tools/next100/itceli/sources.md`, terms in `glossary.md`. Region IT, `[data-theme="itceli"]` (suggested 160 45% 24%), borrows the civics tiger.
